_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 14:21 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE HOURLY RUN. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which discharges the exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable because no position carries one. ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22, so the broker itself - not the empty position list - is what establishes that the 09:49 specification has not been executed. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. ONE SPECIFICATION IS LIVE AGAINST IT AND IT IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED FOR THE FIFTH HOUR: 2 SMTC at a 138.50 limit, costing at most 277.00 - 27.4% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, leaving 732.16 uncommitted. THE HOUR'S FINDING IS A CHANGE OF STATE, NOT OF PRICE: THE SPECIFICATION STOPPED BEING MARKETABLE. For four hours the market sat at or under 138.50 and an operator could have filled instantly. At 13:56 ET SMTC broke away on a 21,884-share minute - 6.7x the minute before, inside the heaviest five-minute bucket in two hours at 42,061 shares - and from 13:57 through 14:21 twenty-five consecutive minute bars printed their entire range above the limit, the lowest low 138.800, with the 14:05 bar printing 139.970, the highest trade since the 10:50 bucket. SMTC is 139.16 bid / 139.38 ask at 18:21:44.408899131Z on a 0.158% spread, so the limit now rests 0.66 UNDER the bid and needs a 0.47% give-back to fill. All three invalidations were tested mechanically and none tripped, and for the first time since publication NOT ONE BUFFER NARROWED: 2.96 on the 132.60 print test, unchanged; 5.58 on the NVDA 205.00 test, WIDER than 5.10 an hour ago and the first hour in four that it has not eroded; 2.285 on the 134.00 five-minute-close test, unchanged, with the volume half that went live last hour back off at 30,266 shares against 30,374. THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED TO 139.16 TO GUARANTEE THE FILL, which is the exact scenario the 09:49 entry pre-committed to by name and by hour.

entryWatch.setup: SMTC post-earnings day 1 - reported 8/25 after the close, SPECIFIED at 09:49 at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED at 10:22, 11:22, 12:21, 13:21 and again at 14:21
entryWatch.trigger: STILL LIVE AT 138.50, QUOTES CURRENT, INVALIDATIONS UNTOUCHED - AND THE SPECIFICATION HAS STOPPED BEING MARKETABLE, WHICH IS THIS HOUR'S REAL CONTENT. SMTC is 139.16 bid / 139.38 ask at 2026-08-26T18:21:44.408899131Z, last 139.295, +9.23% against the 127.520 settled close, on a 0.158% spread. For four consecutive re-quotes the 138.50 limit sat AT or ABOVE the offer - immediately marketable for a buy - and the 11:22 run recorded the level genuinely printing. THAT ENDED AT 13:56 ET, TO THE MINUTE. That bar printed a 138.160 low, then opened 138.215 and closed 139.3842 with a 139.750 high on 21,884 shares against 3,275 in the minute before, a 6.7x expansion, inside a five-minute bucket that traded 42,061 shares - the heaviest in two hours. FROM 13:57 THROUGH 14:21, TWENTY-FIVE CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS HAVE PRINTED THEIR ENTIRE RANGE ABOVE 138.50, the lowest low among them 138.800 at 14:10, and the 14:05 bar printed 139.970 - the highest trade since the 10:50 ET bucket, a three-hour-fifteen-minute high. The limit now rests 0.66 UNDER the bid and 0.88 under the ask, and filling it requires a 0.47% give-back that is not currently being offered. THE READ OF THE SESSION IS NOW THREE-LEGGED AND EACH RUN OWNS ITS OWN ERROR: 12:21 called a defended double bottom at 136.500, 13:21 withdrew that after the 12:47 break to 135.560 and described a lower low with a full reclaim, and neither anticipated that the reclaim would not stop at the shelf. The 137.50-138.24 shelf the entry was struck at is now 0.9-1.2% BELOW the market rather than around it, so the STEP 2b test gets a more honest answer than a clean yes: the thesis is intact and the tape is confirming it, and the ENTRY is what has gone stale, because it was written to buy a give-back no longer on offer. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED MECHANICALLY AT 14:21 AND NONE TRIPPED, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE PUBLICATION NOT ONE BUFFER NARROWED. FIRST, a print below 132.60: NOT TRIPPED by 2.96, unchanged - the lowest post-publication print is still 135.560 from 12:47 and this hour's low was 137.3152 at 13:45, so the three-hour run of narrowing stopped. SECOND, NVDA below 205.00: NOT TRIPPED at 210.58 bid, -1.16% on the day, and the buffer WIDENED to 5.58 from 5.10 - the series reads 5.70, 5.67, 5.27, 5.10, 5.58 and four consecutive hours of erosion into tonight's print ended. It changes nothing about item 3: NVDA still reports tonight and event risk is not undone by an intraday bounce. THIRD, a five-minute close below 134.00 on rising volume: NOT TRIPPED, buffer 2.285 unchanged with the lowest completed post-publication five-minute close still 136.285 in the 12:40 bucket; this hour's lowest completed five-minute close was 137.720 at 13:35. THE VOLUME HALF THAT WENT MARGINALLY LIVE LAST HOUR HAS GONE BACK OFF - 30,266 shares in the 14:10 bucket against 30,374 in the 14:05 bucket, down 0.4% - so where last hour one of two halves was satisfied, this hour neither is. THE FOURTH TEST, THE INSIDE-THE-SPREAD KILL, WAS RULED ON AT 11:22 AGAINST THE GATE AND IS RE-APPLIED RATHER THAN RE-ARGUED, AND IT NOW POINTS THE OTHER WAY: for four hours the ruling had to explain why a limit ABOVE the offer was not stale, and this hour the limit is back where the rulebook expects a buy limit to be, under the market, so the question does not arise. THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED, AND THIS IS THE HOUR THE PRE-COMMITMENT WAS WRITTEN FOR. The 09:49 body named this scenario in advance and named the time: if SMTC runs further from 138.50 it is not chased, re-struck, or nudged toward the market at 14:00 because nothing has filled. It is 14:21, SMTC is 0.66 clear of the limit, and nothing has filled. Raising to 139.16 would guarantee the fill and convert an entry already forced on item 2 into one that fails item 2 a second time on the price at +9.23% - the FUTU refusal, the BJ refusal made twice, the BZ refusal made this morning against this board's own dead entry, and now the same refusal made against this board's own LIVE entry while it is still executable at a worse level. The limit is not lowered either; the 13:21 refusal to chase 135.56 downward stands. 69 MINUTES REMAIN ON THE 15:30 FUSE, and the operator was notified here rather than at 15:17, which would fire with 13 minutes left. If SMTC is never bought this expires as the fifteenth consecutive unexecuted entry and the first to die with its named level having genuinely traded, at length and on volume - a delivery failure rather than a thesis failure.
entryWatch.why: FORCED ON ITEMS 2 AND 3 AND CLEAN ON THE OTHER FOUR. Item 1 is a 24.6% beat - Q2 EPS 0.71 against a 0.57 estimate, verified on a live calendar pull. Item 5 is the reason it ranks first and it is the strongest on the board: SMTC was marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print, 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24, on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average - expectations cut into the report, not raised into it - and the beat came in bigger than the markdown, with the 138.50 limit still 10.2% below the 8/17 high. Item 4 passes on a 0.17% spread and 45k-82k share minutes through the breakout. ITEM 2 FAILS OUTRIGHT at +13.90%, with the whole board green alongside it (ANF +28.4%, BZ +15.2%), which item 2's second sentence calls a wait signal. ITEM 3 FAILS ON PULLED NUMBERS: NVDA reports TONIGHT and its 8/28 212.50 straddle is 12.55 against a 211.93 spot, a 5.92% implied move at 94% IV landing inside the five-session window; SMTC's own 9/18 135 straddle is 23.55 on ~137, 17.2% over 23 days at 82% IV - elevated even with SMTC's own earnings behind it, which is the spillover being priced - scaling by sqrt(5/23) to 8.0% against an 8% stop, putting the stop exactly on the one-sigma line. Options were priced and refused on spread for the fifth session running: the 9/18 135 call is 14.20/16.00 at 11.9% of mark and the put 7.90/9.00 at 13.0%, both outside the 10% ceiling, on the only expiry satisfying the 3-6 week rule since SMTC lists no weeklies. THE NVDA COLLISION IS NAMED, NOT BURIED: this board committed on 8/21 and again in the 8/25 pre-close to being flat into tonight's print, and this entry contradicts that. The 15:35 pre-close owns the overnight decision explicitly on live quotes.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 2 - the 8/25 specification at 15.95 expired unexecuted and is NOT re-struck
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED TODAY ON THIS BOARD'S OWN MOST-REFUSED BEHAVIOUR, WHICH IS THE POINT WORTH RECORDING. BZ is 18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 2026-08-26T13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against the 16.290 close, on a 0.21% spread. Yesterday's thesis was RIGHT and delivery is what failed: a fill at 15.95 would now be +2.81 a share, +17.6%. That does not make BZ buyable at 18.73. Buying it here is re-striking a dead 15.95 limit 17.4% higher to chase a name that got away, which is exactly what the 2026-08-18 change forbids - widening the time is not permission to widen the price - and it is the refusal this board has already made at FUTU 117.90 and twice at BJ 97.35. It is now made against this board's own entry, which is the harder version and the one that counts. DAY 2 IS ALSO A CONTINUATION SPIKE, NOT THE PULLBACK ITEM 2 PREFERS: BZ opened 16.765, ran to 19.00 by 09:39 and has held 18.5-18.9 since, so there has been no give-back to buy at any point today.
entryWatch.why: The 8/25 entry was FORCED on item 2, confirmed six times by the hourly runs with all three pre-registered invalidations tested at each and none ever tripped, and it died on its 15:30 fuse with the closing bid 16.225 against the 15.95 limit - the fourteenth consecutive unexecuted entry. It was not carried overnight because a specification that outlives its session is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists. Today's tape vindicates the reasoning and changes nothing about the rule: the level is dead, and a dead level does not come back to life because the name went up.

candidatesNote: Re-quoted at 14:21 ET on 8/26 by the hourly run for the two names that carry a live decision - SMTC, the specified name, and NVDA, which is invalidation two. The other rows still carry their 09:52-09:53 open-run quotes and are labelled as of that time in their own notes; they were not re-pulled because no decision this hour rests on them. THE ONE-LINE READ: SMTC broke away from the 138.50 limit at 13:56 on a 6.7x volume minute and has not traded at or below it in the twenty-five minutes since, so the specification has gone from immediately marketable back to a resting bid 0.66 under the market - and the limit is NOT raised to chase it; NVDA is 210.58 bid, -1.16%, and its 205.00 kill buffer widened to 5.58 from 5.10, the first hour in four it has not eroded into tonight's print.

candidates.note: RE-QUOTED AT 14:21 BY THE HOURLY RUN: 139.16 bid / 139.38 ask at 18:21:44.408899131Z, last 139.295, +9.23% against a 127.520 close on a 0.158% spread. The bid is 1.02 higher than the 138.14 of an hour ago and the highest of the session since 10:50. THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 138.50 limit for 2 shares, FORCED on items 2 and 3, CONFIRMED FOR THE FIFTH HOUR - AND THE SPECIFICATION HAS STOPPED BEING MARKETABLE. For four hours the limit sat at or above the offer; at 13:56 ET SMTC broke away on a 21,884-share minute, 6.7x the one before, and from 13:57 through 14:21 twenty-five consecutive minute bars have printed their entire range above 138.50, the lowest low 138.800, with a 139.970 print at 14:05 - the highest since the 10:50 bucket. The limit now rests 0.66 UNDER the bid and needs a 0.47% give-back to fill. THE THESIS IS UNCHANGED AND WAS NOT RE-ARGUED THIS HOUR. Q2 EPS 0.710 against 0.570, a 24.6% beat, on a name marked DOWN 21.6% into its own print - 154.22 on 8/17 to a 120.91 close on 8/24 - on 8,904,562 shares on 8/25 against a ~2.3M average. ITEM 2 NOW READS +9.23%, the highest since the +13.47% at publication, after +8.40% at 13:21, +8.10% at 12:21 and +7.97% at 11:22. Logged on both sides of the +8% line across five hours and NOT ACTED ON: a forced marking is struck at publication and is not revised by a later tape in either direction. Item 3 still fails on the NVDA print tonight. The forced marking stands, and the limit is neither raised to 139.16 to catch the breakout nor lowered to 135.56 to catch the earlier low.

139.76 bid / 140.40 ask at 13:53:01.472625787Z, last 140.085, +28.64% against a 108.900 close on a 0.46% spread. THE STRONGEST TAPE ON THE BOARD AND REFUSED ON NUMBERS OVER NARRATIVE. It gapped, ran to 141.92, gave back 3.7% to 136.59 and rebuilt to the highs - a genuine intraday pullback-and-reclaim, the healthiest structure here. The refusal is that a 2.42 against 2.37 EPS beat, up 2.1%, cannot be reconciled with a 28.6% move from any number this run pulled: the driver is guidance or comps I cannot see, so buying it means buying a story rather than an arithmetic. It is also a new three-month high, well above the 119.92 high of 8/11, so item 5 reads the wrong way - this is not a name recovering from a markdown, it is one being re-rated into clear air.

18.73 bid / 18.77 ask at 13:53:00.508516304Z, last 18.760, +15.16% against a 16.290 close on a 0.21% spread. Day 2 of the print this board specified yesterday at 15.95, and REFUSED because buying it now is re-striking a dead limit 17.4% higher - the FUTU and BJ refusal applied to this board's own entry. Yesterday's reasoning was right: a fill at 15.95 would be +17.6% now. Delivery failed, not the thesis, and the rule that follows is that widening the time is not permission to widen the price.

130.49 bid / 130.89 ask at 13:52:58.538298541Z, last 130.730, +4.05% against a 125.450 close on a 0.31% spread. Q1 3.24 against 2.22, a 45.9% beat - the largest on the board that the tape did not reject - and the only large-beat name that passes item 2 literally. REFUSED ON ITEM 5: it went INTO the print at the top of a month-long grind, 117.50 on 8/3 to a 125.87 close on 8/24, so expectations were raised into this report rather than cut. The WMT arithmetic applies on top: +20% is 156.88 inside five sessions, which a staples name does not produce, so the exits would be decoration. Faded from a 134.85 open to 130.49, which is the tape agreeing.

30.53 bid / 30.73 ask at 13:53:01.316029278Z, last 30.590, +4.13% against a 29.320 close on a 0.65% spread. A 25% beat (0.50 against 0.40) and THE CLEAREST DISTRIBUTION DAY ON THE BOARD: it opened 37.48, printed 37.91, and has fallen 19.3% from that high with no floor established - a fresh low at 09:41 and lower again by 09:53. Buying it is catching a knife on print day, and it carries the same NVDA event gap as every other semi-cap name into tonight.

16.51 bid / 16.55 ask at 13:52:58.304121771Z, last 16.530, -6.50% against a 17.680 close on a 0.24% spread. EPS 1.28 against 0.55, a 133% beat, AND THE STOCK IS DOWN - it spiked to 17.77 in the second minute and was sold to 16.02. This is item 5 firing the other way: the beat was not the story and the tape said so within two minutes. A beat the market rejects is not a catalyst, it is a warning.

17.56 bid / 17.61 ask at 13:53:03.19769886Z, last 17.5805, +0.00% against a 17.580 close on a 0.28% spread. EPS 0.62 against 0.21, a 195% beat, and the stock is EXACTLY unchanged. Looked at as a sympathy laggard against ANF's +28.6% in the same complex and refused: it is not a name that has not been looked at, it is a name that was looked at and priced. The tape confirms it - opened 18.26, printed 18.73, and bled all morning to 17.43. Not moving would be one thing; going down on a 195% beat is another.

344.23 bid / 344.65 ask at 13:53:01.68357106Z, last 344.430, -3.65% against a 357.460 close on a 0.12% spread. EPS 4.03 against 3.29, a 22.5% beat, and it is DOWN 3.65% and making session lows - crowded bulls into a print meeting a merely-good report, which is item 5 in the textbook shape. One share is also 34.1% of the account, so a two-share position is impossible inside the 40% ceiling regardless of the view.

94.39 bid / 94.43 ask at 13:53:03.204780357Z, last 94.420, +1.42% against a 93.100 close on a 0.04% spread - the tightest quote on this board. Day 2, a genuine grinding continuation off a 7.8% beat, and THE ONLY NAME HERE THAT PASSES ITEM 2 BOTH LITERALLY AND IN SPIRIT. Refused twice over: the WMT arithmetic (+20% is 113.27 on a Canadian bank inside five sessions, which is not a number it produces) and consistency - this board refused BNS in writing yesterday at 89.52 and it is 5.4% higher today, so re-entering is the same dead-level-higher error being refused at BZ.
